lines.text: Posted Readout · Day 7 · test_1 · v1: Scale: Cost per result 2.4 is 0.6x target 4.0 which is <= 0.85x target and results 42 is >= 30, meeting the scale rule [ev-d7-test_1-readout].

Last week started quiet with 0 to act on and ended with 3 to act on by day 7. Streak ad (ad_1) click rate is down 61.7% since day 1 while people see it 7.1 times on average and cost $8.7 per trial over the last 3 days well above the $4 target [ev-d7-ad_1-ctr, ev-d7-ad_1-cpr3]. Test test_1 has run 7 days at 0.6 times the target cost with $2.4 per result versus $4.0 target and 42 results on 100.94 spend and is due for a readout [ev-d7-test_1-readout].
To Analyst: What numbers are reported in ev-w1-ad_4-week and ev-d7-test_1-readout that can be quoted in ad copy, including cost_per_result and any other metrics?

ev-w1-ad_4-week reports cost_per_result 2.4, ctr 0.0217, days_live 7.0, frequency 1.05, results 42.0 and spend 100.94 [ev-w1-ad_4-week]. ev-d7-test_1-readout reports cost_per_result 2.4, cost_ratio_to_target 0.6, days_running 7.0, results 42.0, spend 100.94 and target_cost_per_result 4.0 [ev-d7-test_1-readout].

ev-d7-ad_1-ctr shows frequency 7.1, CTR today 0.009146 versus first day 0.023877 with change -61.7 [ev-d7-ad_1-ctr] and ev-d7-ad_1-cpr3 shows cost per result 8.7 on 3.0 results from 26.11 spend [ev-d7-ad_1-cpr3]. Related test w1-t1 metrics show cost per result 2.4 versus target 4.0 on 42.0 results from 100.94 spend over 7.0 days [ev-d7-test_1-readout] and frequency 1.05 with CTR 0.0217 [ev-w1-ad_4-week].

No evidence given mentions that test name, so no evidence IDs support the ten minute no gear at home workout claim and its hook [ev-d7-test_1-readout] [ev-w1-ad_4-week]. The closest evidence is [ev-w1-ad_4-week] and [ev-d7-test_1-readout] with results 42.0, spend 100.94, cost per result 2.4, days 7.0 and target cost per result 4.0 [ev-w1-ad_4-week] [ev-d7-test_1-readout].
The provided evidence does not include source URLs for the product phrase and cannot answer the question [ev-w1-ad_4-week] [ev-d7-test_1-readout].

Cost per result 2.31 is 0.578x target 4.0 which is at or below the 0.85x scale threshold and results 87 is at or above 30 [ev-d14-test_1-readout].
